issues.claim: In 1582, ten days vanished from the calendar.
issues.problem: Only Catholic countries switched in 1582; Britain and its colonies dropped 11 days in 1752, Russia in 1918.
issues.fix: In 1582, Pope Gregory's reform made ten days vanish from the calendar.

issues.claim: Thursday, October 4 was followed by Friday, October 15.
issues.problem: True for the reform as first adopted (Italy, Spain, Portugal, etc.), not everywhere. Oct 4 -> Oct 15 is confirmed by Wikipedia (Inter gravissimas); the weekdays are confirmed only by the Gregorian calendar page.
issues.fix: In Rome and other Catholic lands, Thursday, October 4 was followed by Friday, October 15.
